labels.heading: Heading
labels.schedule_info: Date and time in the store timezone, e.g. 2026-10-31 23:59. Leave empty for no limit.

brand.name: Brand
brand.share_image_info: Shown when a page without its own image is shared on social media. 1200 × 628 px recommended.

colors.name: Colors
colors.background_gradient_info: Overrides the background color when set.
colors.heading: Headings & links

cart.name: Cart
cart.free_shipping_threshold_info: Store currency, whole units (e.g. 100). A shop metafield custom.free_shipping_threshold overrides this value, so headless storefronts can share it.
cart.upsell_products_info: Shown in the cart drawer and on the cart page, skipping products already in the cart.
cart.show_cart_discount_info: Shoppers can apply and remove discount codes in the cart drawer and on the cart page.
cart.show_cart_sku: Show SKU under the product image
cart.show_cart_recommendations: Show recommended products next to the cart drawer
cart.show_cart_recommendations_info: Related products Shopify picks for the items in the cart. Loaded only when the cart opens, shown beside the drawer on desktop and as a closable sheet on phones.

saved.name: Wishlist & compare
saved.info: Heart and compare buttons on product cards. Lists are kept in the shopper's browser. Create pages with the "wishlist" and "compare" templates (handles wishlist and compare).

behavior.name: Behavior
behavior.view_transitions_info: Cross-fades between pages in supporting browsers (View Transitions API).
behavior.prefetch_links_info: Starts loading the next page when a shopper hovers a link, so it opens faster (Speculation Rules API).

integrations.name: Integrations
integrations.info: Connections to the theme’s own API (project-server).
integrations.api_url_info: Base URL of project-server, e.g. https://api.example.com. Empty: the newsletter uses the standard Shopify form.
integrations.recaptcha_site_key_info: Protects the newsletter from bots. Its secret key goes into the server settings.

store.name: Store details
store.info: Contacts and social profiles for the footer, the contact page and search engines (structured data). One place for the whole site.

cart_drawer.name: Cart drawer
cart_drawer.info: Upsell products, order note and the free shipping bar are set in Theme settings > Cart. Add blocks to collect order details.

main_cart.name: Cart
main_cart.show_dynamic_checkout_info: Shop Pay, Apple Pay, PayPal and other accelerated checkouts enabled in your store.

header.menu_info: Links with sub-links open a dropdown. A third level, or a menu block targeting the link, turns it into a mega menu.
header.transparent_info: Overlays the first section of the home page and turns solid on scroll.
header.transparent_text_color: Text and icons on transparent header
header.logo_transparent_info: Optional light version of the logo.
header.show_utility_panel_info: An icon in the header that opens a panel with account and quick links plus currency and language switchers.
header.show_currency_info: Lists the currencies of your Shopify Markets countries.
header.utility_menu_info: Optional menu shown in the panel, e.g. shipping, returns, contacts.
header.search_blocks_info: Add Search term, Quick link, Products and Collections blocks to fill the panel before the shopper types.

footer.show_policies_info: Refund, privacy, terms and shipping policies from Settings > Policies.
footer.brand_info: Logo from Theme settings > Brand; social profiles from Theme settings > Store details.
footer.contacts_info: Address, phone, email and opening hours from Theme settings > Store details.
footer.products_list_info: Used instead of the collection when set.

announcements.name: Announcement bar
announcements.autoplay_info: 0 = only with the arrows. Applies when there are two or more messages.

countdown.name: Countdown bar
countdown.end_info: Date and time in the store timezone, e.g. 2026-10-31 23:59. The bar hides itself after that.
countdown.image_info: Shown softly behind the text, under the color scheme background.

newsletter.name: Newsletter
newsletter.layout_inline: Text and form in one row
newsletter.image_info: Banner layout: shown on the left.
newsletter.color_scheme_info: A scheme with a background gradient makes a bold banner.

promo_popup.name: Promo popup
promo_popup.delay_info: Seconds after the page opens. 0 turns it off when another trigger is set.
promo_popup.scroll_info: Share of the page scrolled. 0 = off.
promo_popup.exit_intent_info: Desktop only: the pointer moves out at the top of the window.
promo_popup.days_info: After it is closed. 0 = not again in this visit. After a newsletter sign-up it stays away for a year.
promo_popup.image_info: Shown beside the content on larger screens.
promo_popup.success_text_info: For example the discount code. Create the code in Discounts.
promo_popup.already_text: Text for an email already subscribed
promo_popup.discount_code_info: Added to the cart right after signing up, so the shopper doesn't need to copy it. Create the code in Discounts.

hero.name: Hero
hero.image_mobile_info: Optional, a portrait crop works best. Empty: the main image.
hero.overlay_info: 0 = off. Card and side by side: an even tint over the image. Text over the image: a gradient from the text side.
hero.color_scheme_info: Colors the caption: the card, the text side, or the text over the image.
hero.autoplay_info: 0 = off, slides change only by swiping or with the arrows. Pauses while the shopper points at or focuses the slider.
hero.video_info: Always muted, looping, without controls; plays inline on phones and shows its frame at the start second right away. With a video the image is only a fallback for visitors who turned animations off. Upload in Content > Files; short (10–20 s) and light (under 5 MB).
hero.video_mobile_info: Optional, a vertical crop works best.
hero.caption: Caption style
hero.caption_info: The color scheme colors the caption: the panel, the text side, or the text over the image.
hero.caption_split: Image and text side by side
hero.video_end_info: The part between start and end loops. 0 = to the end of the video.
hero.loop_info: After the last slide the arrows and autoplay go back to the first one. Off: the slider stops at the ends.

product_list.name: Product list
product_list.deal_product_info: Shown first, highlighted, with a countdown.
product_list.deal_end_info: Date and time, e.g. 2026-12-24 23:59. Empty: no timer, the highlight stays.

collection_list.name: Collection list
collection_list.collections_info: Empty: all collections with products, except those with "Hide from collection lists" ticked in the collection's metafields.

page_header.name: Page header
page_header.heading_info: Empty: the page, collection or blog title.
page_header.text_info: Empty: the collection or blog description.

faq.name: FAQ
faq.single_open: One answer open at a time
faq.question: Question

brands.name: Brands
brands.brand_name_info: Shown when there is no logo; also the logo's text for screen readers.

rich_text.name: Rich text
rich_text.collapse_info: With a "Read more" button. The full text stays on the page for search engines.

main_contact.name: Contact form
main_contact.info: Phone, email, address and hours come from Theme settings > Store details. The page text shows above them. Messages go to the store sender email (Settings > Notifications).

main_list_collections.name: Collections
main_list_collections.layout_info: Bento: tick "Featured in collection lists" in a collection's metafields for a large tile (else the first collection is large).

main_blog.name: Blog posts
main_blog.featured_info: The newest article is shown large on the first page.

menu_item.label: Menu link
menu_item.info: Title of the top-level menu link this content belongs to, e.g. "Shop".

search_term.name: Search: popular term
search_term.info: Shown as a popular search chip.

search_products.name: Search: products
search_products.heading: Heading
search_products.products_info: Hand-picked products take priority over the collection.
